title: EXPLOSIONS BURST
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 13, bigger explosions), in the gritty grounded look he picked (answer 20). A charge or a Howler shell going off was a spray of orange sparks, one puff and a flash of light: no fire, nothing in the air afterwards. Now every burst has a fireball that swells and dies in a third of a second, a shockwave ring, a column of smoke that rises and drifts for three or four seconds, and chunks of debris thrown out on arcs that land and lie there before they fade. It is all drawing: the damage, the blast radius, the light flash and the sound are exactly as they were, nothing here touches the raid dice, and bot raids skip it. Effects set to low throws fewer pieces.
now: Explosions burst: fireball, shockwave, smoke column and flying debris.
